decisions.rationale: Converted Fortinet FortiNDR Cloud - Events Detected analytic rule to Defender XDR Custom Detection with 1:1 KQL parity over Fortinet_FortiNDR_Cloud parser and FncEventsDetections_CL, FncEventsObservation_CL, and FncEventsSuricata_CL tables.

Migrated FortinetFortiNdrCloudWorkbook.json to Defender XDR workbook surface (Microsoft.Security/workbooks) with disambiguated parameter names and EventType column projection across all 21 KQL queries.
